mission: search and rescue, camera looks straight down
about: The one situation list. label_tool.py and prepare_data.py read the classes, export_c.py writes the firmware table (situations.c) from it. thr / thr_low / n_on / m_off are the tracker settings per SWEEP (see tracker.h); pick thr from the table evaluate.py prints. size_px = typical target size in the 320x240 frame from 25-30 m (about 10 cm per pixel), used to scale downloaded images.

classes.name: normal
classes.note: Empty terrain. Never labelled: every frame outside an event is normal.

classes.name: person
classes.note: A person seen from above (standing, lying, waving). Stop, hold, report the position.

classes.name: landing_marker
classes.note: An H or another clear marker on the ground. Centre, descend while correcting, land (if the FC allows it).

classes.name: vehicle_wreck
classes.note: A large man-made object: car, tent, wreckage. Stop and report.
